work.abstract_text: The formula at line 12 of the pinned official export of OEIS A146304, revision 35 (February 16, 2025), conjectures that the number a(n) of inclusion-maximal nonattacking bishop subsets of the fixed-coordinate n by n board is O(n^(n-1)); extending Arshon's enumeration (1936, pp. 25-29) to distinguishable maximal completions disproves this growth law. For integers n >= 3 and 1 <= t <= n-2, prescribing occupied difference diagonals and recovering the seeds from maximal extensions gives t^(2(n-1-t)) <= a(n), while a staircase-board embedding gives a(n) <= A(n) <= B(n+2)^2, where A(n) counts all nonattacking subsets and B(j) is the jth Bell number. Thus log(a(n)) and log(A(n)) equal 2n(log(n)-log(log(n))-1) + O(n log(log(n))/log(n)), and a(n)^(1/(2n)) is asymptotic to n/(e log(n)). Each color has the corresponding one-color estimate. The largest coefficients have the same root estimates, and the proportion of placements with fewer than (2-epsilon)n bishops tends to zero for every fixed epsilon > 0.

work.title: The OEIS maximal-bishop growth conjecture: an extension of Arshon's enumeration
